I focused on where `ns_clk` is being driven twice—once as an SV-always clock toggle in the testbench top and once in the DPI C code. To fix this you’ll need to edit

1. the top.v testbench (eliminate or rename the extra driver)
2. the DPI module’s C implementation/header (so you only drive `ns_clk` once)

The four most likely files to touch are:
```
